shorts.title: A Hyena Eats the Meat, the Bones and Even the Hair
shorts.outro: Later, Doug offered it a pet-shop chew bone with a bow on it. It wanted his walking stick instead. The full video is below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT HAPPENED TO DOUG'S WALKING STICK?
shorts.description: A spotted hyena eats the skeleton too (one captive hyena bit with about 4,500 newtons), and what it wanted from Doug next is in the full episode.

shorts.title: A Hyena's Laugh Isn't Laughter, It's a Status Report
shorts.outro: That whoop is how a clan of up to a hundred and thirty finds you. Doug counted to twelve. It's in the full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT HAPPENED AFTER DOUG COUNTED TWELVE?
shorts.description: A hyena's giggle tells listeners its age and rank, but the whoop is the call that brings the clan, and what happened after Doug counted twelve is in the full episode.

shorts.title: This Ethiopian City Has 16 Holes in Its Wall for Hyenas
shorts.outro: Two hours later, Doug hid behind a pride of lionesses for safety. Then the lions got up and walked away from him. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHY DID THE LIONS LEAVE DOUG?
shorts.description: Wild hyenas have walked the streets of Harar for at least 500 years, and why the lions left Doug is answered in the full episode.
